description.en: Granules form distinct geometric shapes naturally and can be found like these as granulation decoration on antique jewellery throughout different cultures, from the Etruscans to the Assyrians. The pyramid of four spheres is one of them. As all LURI pieces, these studs are crafted entirely by hand.
